description: Vertical Bar Agent helps authorized teams inspect CrossCheck snapshots and process-mining data, analyze dependencies and telemetry, build grounded Briefings, manage test suites and release packages, and run governed NetSuite workflows through ChatGPT. It also helps author and publish Stress Test contracts, open their CrossCheck page to start a Run, and inspect Run progress and results. Agent-started Stress Test runs are available only in active sandbox or release-preview environments.
